name: std::latch::arrive_and_wait
intro:
Atomically decrements the internal counter by n and (if necessary) blocks the calling 
thread until the counter reaches zero. Equivalent to count_down(n); wait();.

If n is greater than the value of the internal counter or is negative, the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
n

 -

 the value by which the internal counter is decreased

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: Throws std::system_error with an error code allowed for mutex types on error.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
